text_zh: 其芯燃而不尽，铅灯照亮更深之层。唯油壶满溢者，方可久立于黑暗。
text_en: Its wick burns without end, casting lead-light into deeper vaults. Only the oil-blessed may linger long in darkness.

text_zh:
汝铸己身为流沙之器——承载更深的祷告。
